inclusion_rule: Studies that produce audible speech (waveform or vocoder/spectral parameters rendered as audio) from non-acoustic speech-production signals measured on the speaker (ultrasound, lip video together with such signals, EMA/PMA, EMG, EPG, neural recordings), classified by output route: recognition then synthesis (phones or words are recognized and a unit-selection, concatenative or text-to-speech synthesizer renders them) versus direct mapping (frame-wise regression, GMM, neural network or lookup from signal features to acoustic parameters). Boundary: exclude talking-head or face animation, acoustic-to-articulatory inversion, articulatory synthesizers driven by model parameters or text rather than measured signals, conversion from acoustic input (NAM, whisper, electrolarynx), and reviews; versions count once; earlier versions of the target system are merged with the target.
